skill.displayName: Yufluent Clawhub Publish Yufluentcn Comp Scrape

llm.summary: This is a disclosed cloud client for competitor CSV/API-snapshot analysis, with no artifact evidence of hidden persistence, destructive behavior, or automatic data theft.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is batch competitor comparison from user-provided CSV exports or authorized API snapshots, and the main script builds that payload and submits it to the documented Yufluent skill API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The documentation repeatedly says processing is cloud-based and forbids unauthorized scraping, but users should still understand that competitor data and optional listing text are sent off-device.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install metadata requires only TOKENAPI_KEY and a pip install of requests; no install hooks, obfuscated commands, or unexpected package activity were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: TOKENAPI_BASE_URL can redirect authenticated requests and defaults to plain HTTP localhost, so this should only be configured to a trusted Yufluent endpoint or a controlled local test service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background worker, persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, broad local indexing, or destructive file action was found; file reads are limited to explicit input paths and output writing requires an explicit flag.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending the provided competitor CSV/API snapshot and optional listing text to Yufluent for cloud processing. Keep TOKENAPI_KEY private, avoid including secrets or personal data in the uploaded inputs, and do not set TOKENAPI_BASE_URL unless you trust that endpoint.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: The main network POST with TOKENAPI_KEY and user payload matches the disclosed cloud-client design; the configurable base URL is a real misconfiguration risk but not hidden behavior.
[TT3] unexpected: The outcome-reporting helper posts to /agent/outcomes with the same token, but it is not called by the reviewed primary workflow, so it is dormant rather than active telemetry in normal use.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Outcome reporting is not clearly part of competitor analysis, but artifact evidence shows it as an unused helper rather than an automatic side channel.
[SQP-1] expected: Some trigger phrases are broad, but the skill instructions require source confirmation and required competitor-data parameters before running the cloud call.
[SQP-2] expected: The script sends user-supplied competitor data to a remote/cloud API as documented; stronger runtime confirmation and retention disclosure would improve user clarity.
